ctx.x: Well, I guess a lot of musicians who have played with Hardy, I guess Ray Burt was one that played with him early. But I forgot what interview it was. They were talking about his sound being the pure New Orleans sound, but with a sweet tone that was not characteristic of New Orleans sound. But they say that Buddy Molden, too. But also that Emmett had played in Davenport for a while, and Bix had heard him there. And that he...
I got the second reel on. Okay. Mr. Huck. Ready to go. Okay. You want to ask a question?

Yeah, well, it's just that is there any value in trying to say that... trying to trace this to Emmett Hardy or what? I mean, it's obvious that Emmett Hardy was probably a great musician. I mean, you know, a lot of people testify to that. And that he probably had an influence on Bix's style. But what did Bix have... what did he contribute to the course of musical development? I guess you could say of jazz since the New Orleans style. Was his influence or contribution musically a harmonic in his use of harmonies?…
